integrity: Exact finite-state rational verification supplements, but does not replace, the analytic proof; no independent validation has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns a two-proposal walk sampled independently with replacement on cycles and its mean-optimal distance-greedy policy only; no tailwise/variance optimality or general graph extension. Earlier equivalent birth-death formulations remain possible.
title: Exact optimal hitting-time fluctuations for a two-choice walk on a cycle
